name: Pixy2 (CMUcam5) smart camera
description: A small 60 fps vision sensor that learns colour objects and tracks lines, intersections and road signs on board, with built-in LED lighting. It returns object blocks to an Arduino or Pi over SPI, I²C, UART or USB.

variants.note: SparkFun SKU, 10-pin I/O connector, includes Arduino ISP cable

kicad.footprintNote: Ready-made module: wire it up with a connector or header

notes: 60 fps is the processing rate. getFPS() reports 2–62 fps depending on light. Results come back as blocks and vectors, not full-resolution images.
Lens is 60°×40° (H×V). Draws 140 mA typical from USB 5 V or 6–10 V unregulated input.
Uses an NXP LPC4330 (204 MHz dual-core) with 264 KB RAM and 2 MB flash. Also has digital and analog outputs.
